campbell.title: Campbell City Council — July 7, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered renewing an interim ordinance related to state Senate Bill implementation, along with two separate hearings on revoking the business license and tobacco retailer permit for California Cigar and for Hayes Smoke Shop. The council also considered authorizing a grant application for public works funding and approving new consultant service agreements.
keyTopics: Renewal of an interim ordinance implementing a state Senate Bill
Revocation of business license and tobacco retailer permit for California Cigar
Revocation of business license and tobacco retailer permit for Hayes Smoke Shop
Authorization to submit a grant application through the Public Works Department
Approval of consultant service agreements

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — May 6, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council considered routine steps for an annual assessment district, including preliminary approval of an Engineer's Report and a Resolution of Intention, followed by a public hearing on the matter. The Council also reviewed whether Saratoga should explore becoming a charter city and looked at early estimates of possible new local tax options and how much revenue they might generate.
keyTopics: Preliminary approval of the Engineer's Report for an annual assessment district
Resolution of Intention and related public hearing on assessments
Scheduling an ordinance for adoption at the May 20, 2026 meeting
Discussion of charter city status and potential next steps
Review of preliminary tax options and revenue estimates for the city

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — August 4, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council considered routine administrative and contract items, including approving minutes from prior meetings and authorizing amendments to several service agreements, such as tree care, legal services, and library book purchases. The council also planned to review the town's monthly financial and investment report.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from June 16 and June 23, 2026 council meetings
Fourth amendment to the tree care services agreement with Brightview
Fifth amendment to the town's legal services contract
Purchase of library books and materials from Ingram for the fiscal year
Review of the monthly financial and investment report

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — August 5, 2026
san-jose.summary: This was an administrative planning meeting where the City Council committee reviewed and finalized the agenda for the upcoming August 11, 2026 council meeting and previewed a draft agenda for August 18, 2026. Committee members also considered whether any items needed special scheduling or waiver notices, and reviewed the public record covering mid-June through late July 2026.
keyTopics: Finalizing the August 11, 2026 City Council meeting agenda
Adding new items to the August 11 final agenda
Previewing and shaping the draft agenda for August 18, 2026
Considering 'time certain' scheduling for specific agenda items
Reviewing the public record from June 11 to July 29, 2026

mountain-view.title: Mountain View City Council — June 23, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The Mountain View City Council closed with a closed-door legal session on possible lawsuits, then handled several honorary proclamations, including one for outgoing City Attorney Jennifer Logue's appointment to the judiciary. On the business side, the Council considered the city's annual budget cap, updates to financial policy, a long-term water supply and shortage plan, next year's list of capital construction projects, and several public works items covering a new public safety building, repaving the Shoreline Golf Links parking lot, and salt pond restoration work along the South Bay.
keyTopics: Closed session on potential litigation against the city
Proclamations for Immigrant Heritage Month, the Kiwanis Club's 100th anniversary, and City Attorney Jennifer Logue's judicial appointment
Fiscal Year 2026-27 budget appropriations limit and financial policy updates
5-year Urban Water Management and Water Shortage Contingency Plan update
Capital projects including the Public Safety Building, Shoreline Golf Links parking lot repaving, and South Bay Salt Pond Restoration

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — July 28, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council met on July 28, 2026, starting with a closed session followed by a study session focused on updates to the city's artificial turf policy. During the regular meeting, the Council also considered routine business items, including approving city bill payments, amending a landfill services contract, and placing charges for unpaid utility bills onto property tax bills for the coming fiscal year.
keyTopics: Artificial Turf Policy Study Update (study session)
Amending the landfill services agreement with SCS Field Services, Inc.
Placing delinquent utility charges on the Santa Clara County property tax roll
Approval of routine city claims and bill payments
Closed session held before the public study session

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — July 21, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council met in closed session to discuss ongoing lawsuits with its legal counsel. The cases involve a dispute brought by Lixin (Leon) Chen and others against the city, a lawsuit from the group Yes in My Backyard, and a case brought by the Garden Gate Coalition for Mary Avenue Safety. Because this was a legal counsel session about active litigation, no public discussion or debate took place on the substance of these cases.
keyTopics: Lawsuit: Lixin (Leon) Chen, et al. v. City of Cupertino
Lawsuit: Yes in My Backyard, et al. v. City of Cupertino
Lawsuit: Garden Gate Coalition for Mary Avenue Safety v. City of Cupertino
Closed-session legal strategy discussion with city attorneys

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — May 26, 2026
santa-clara.summary: Santa Clara's City Council and Stadium Authority Board held a special joint meeting to consider hiring the California Highway Patrol for traffic management services tied to the FIFA World Cup, at a projected cost of about $1.6 million. The Council also considered a related amendment to the city budget to cover this expense.
keyTopics: Agreement with California Highway Patrol for FIFA World Cup traffic management
$1.6 million projected cost for traffic services
Related city budget amendment
Joint meeting of City Council and Stadium Authority Board

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — April 7, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council considered a substantial amendment to its 2025-2030 Consolidated Plan and 2025-2026 funding allocations, which guide how the city spends federal housing and community development money. Council members also reviewed a list of new workplan items requested by individual councilmembers and considered an ordinance to change how council vacancies are filled and shorten related timelines.
keyTopics: Amendment to the 2025-2030 Consolidated Plan and 2025-2026 funding allocations
New workplan item requests from individual councilmembers
Ordinance to amend the council vacancy process and reduce timelines
Upcoming City Council meeting calendar
Preview of items planned for the next regular council meeting

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto City Council — July 8, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto City Council began with a routine Director's Report covering meeting schedules and assignments, then held a public hearing on a proposal to rezone 470 Olive Avenue from single-family residential to medium-density mixed use. The change would also update the North Ventura area's land use plan so the property's zoning matches the mixed-use designation already in place on the neighboring parcel at 2951 El Camino Real.
keyTopics: Director's Report on upcoming meeting schedule and council assignments
Public hearing on rezoning 470 Olive Avenue from single-family residential (NV-R1) to medium-density mixed use (NV-MXM)
Proposed amendment to the North Ventura Coordinated Area Plan land use designation
Aligning zoning with the adjacent mixed-use parcel at 2951 El Camino Real
Quasi-judicial land use decision process for the Olive Avenue property
